name: F5: Howling Winds
description: Rulebook Table 99 (p.554). Floor 5 (The Bubbles), Howling Winds Neighborhood — random complications for grinding among the Pterolykos and the City Elves of Castle Contractors, near Wolfwind Village and the Elven Camp.

results.name: Elder Silkpaw's question
results.description: An elder Pterolykos (Elder Silkpaw, unless he is dead) is sitting upon the edge of the Cliff, staring out in a meditative trance. As you approach, he will ask, deceptively calmly, "Do you walk among the trees? Or do you desire them for your own?"

results.name: Clear-Cutter ambush amid smoke and ash
results.description: The crawlers have entered a section of the forest that smells of smoke and ash. Nearby, the Cliff's edge looms ominously. There's a whirring sound, and a tree falls as an Elven Clear-Cutter crawls up from the side of the Cliff and attacks. At the same time, two Clear-Cutters charge from the direction of the Lower Montane.

results.name: Captured Pterolykos in a net
results.description: City Elves have captured a Pterolykos in a net that has been tightened against a tree. They cackle as it struggles and threatens them. They begin to ready a spell as the crawlers watch.

results.name: Pit trap and Pterolykos hunting party
results.description: A crawler must make a roll to avoid falling into a pit trap. Whether they avoid it or not, a Moderate Pterolykos hunting party drops from above, proceeding to surround the party as one remains in the canopy, aiming a rifle at the party.

results.name: City Elf trappers drop from a drone helicopter
results.description: As the crawlers hike through the forest, there's a distinct feeling they're being followed. Suddenly, the cloud fog begins to part around them. This seems like a positive thing until a Moderate group of City Elf trappers drops from a drone helicopter, and all of them begin whooping as they attack the crawlers.

results.name: Jerry Madd and Renato Martin 5 chase a Pterolykos
results.description: Crawlers Jerry Madd and Renato Martin 5 are chasing a Pterolykos through the woods, trying to help City Elf trappers catch it. They're being incredibly careful and gentle with the wolf-person, but it's clear they're working with the City Elves.
